teacher_info.about_teacher:
The main thing about me as a teach is that I care about my students’ success. So I adapt to each student's objectives, their learning style, and their strengths. 
In my Business English classes, I bring my business acumen into the classroom. I leverage my own experience to relate to students' needs.
In my conversation classes, we take it easy and explore topics that students enjoy: cute pets, artificial intelligence, money, travel, or whatever it may be.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
We talk a lot in my classes! I suggest new vocabulary, idioms, and phrases to help students be more precise, concise and to strike the right tone. 
I correct recurrent grammar mistakes with short explanations and one-the-spot practice.
When we're not in class, I encourage students to soak up more English. I recommend news articles, short stories, podcasts, and videos in line with students' interests. 
I also encourage students to bring their own topics to class. I often help them practice difficult presentations, write emails that truly convey their messages, and prepare for interviews and meetings.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Thanks to my own my experience in marketing and consulting, I can quickly understand a wide range of business situations. I can also anticipate many of the challenges you might face. In my Business English classes, I leverage this expertise to cut straight to the points that will have the biggest impact on your ability to communicate clearly and effectively.  

Some of the topics I can help with are:
•	Giving clear presentations
•	Getting your messages across in meetings and calls
•	Writing high quality reports and emails
•	Writing your cover letter, resume (CV), or LinkedIn profile
•	Preparing for interviews, performance reviews, or career conversations.  

I will suggest articles, podcasts, and TedTalks depending on your level and area of expertise. We can also work with your real-life business cases.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation classes
pro_course_detail.description:
You will be free to speak about any topics you choose. I will adapt to the right speed for you: possible, but also a bit challenging.
I will pay close attention to your language gaps and give you feedback on the spot. We'll correct grammar mistakes and I'll teach you new vocabulary, collocations, and idiomatic expressions that can help you become more fluent and articulate.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
I have helped over 200 professionals in different fields to prepare for the job interviews in America or for international roles. I love seeing my students succeed and land their dream job! 
In these classes, I leverage things I've learned in my corporate career, my experience working with star-ups and SMEs, and coaching skills I've developed through practice and courses.
Some of what we can do together in these classes is:
- Anticipate potential interview questions
- Explore your experience to identify relevant examples
- Craft powerful stories using typical interview strategies
- Tweak key language points to make your messages clearer
- Do an interview role-plan including small talk

pro_course_detail.title: Basic Program
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a short pre-set program of up to 5 classes, with a fixed plan. In each class, we will explore a different topic, adapted to your level.
Before each class, you will receive a video, article, or podcast that you can use to prepare. 
In class, we will have a conversation, learn vocabulary, and I will offer on-the-spot feedback.

Topics:
Travel. Is overtourism ruining the cities we love?
Pets. The benefits and downsides of having a cat or dog at home. 
Work. Working from home and going to the office in a post-pandemic world. 
Luck. Superstitions, lucky charms, and divine intervention. 
The future. Fast forward to 2044. What does the world look like?
